# PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI

Standard vehicle drive (engine, gears, clutch and an optional automatic gear box) on the vehicle [prim](glossary.md#prim) or on a separate prim that physxVehicle:drive targets. Outside the drive parse the runtime only checks whether the vehicle prim itself lists it, to take the vehicle prim as the drive when physxVehicle:drive has no target.

- **Applies to:** [`Typed`](glossary.md#typed)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Interactions

- **[`PhysxVehicleAPI`](PhysxVehicleAPI.md):** Listing both PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI and PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI on a vehicle prim without a physxVehicle:drive target logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
- **[`PhysxVehicleTankControllerAPI`](PhysxVehicleTankControllerAPI.md):** A tank controller requires a standard drive.

## Notes

- The runtime resolves physxVehicleDriveStandard:engine, gears, autoGearBox and clutch (the relationship target, or the drive prim itself when it lists the matching component API) and wires the parsed components into the drive; their components' columns are not described yet.
